11046|28b8dee2.name: Whuut
11046|28b8dee2.text: Why should I pace myself if this is working?

11066|f7f14434.name: Jhag
11066|f7f14434.text: You come to wrong place. Talk to the expert Godan over there. You learn more from him.

12724|39b67c2e.name: Pixel
12724|39b67c2e.text: This forest can be confusing! Be careful out there.

12737|aa838c4f.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
12737|aa838c4f.text:
If you want to know about the comings and goings of caravans and merchants here in Splintertree Post, then I am fortunately the orc you are looking for.  Unfortunately for you though, I don't like people.

If you want something, make it quick.

15309|d11310f6.name: Spoops
15309|d11310f6.text: I'm sad!  It's Hallow's End, and I'm sick.  I'm going to miss out on trick-or-treating because I can't go out!

15354|658164d5.name: Rachelle Gothena
15354|658164d5.text: Happy Hallow's End!  How do you like my mask?  Very scary!

15354|ce69abe3.name: Rachelle Gothena
15354|ce69abe3.text:
What ISN'T there to do, you mean!

Each of the innkeepers throughout the world are handing out trick-or-treat goodies, and many of the towns are decorated for the season!  Also, there is the Wickerman Festival just outside the Undercity during the evenings.

One more thing - I've heard that a sick little girl at the orphanage here in Orgrimmar is looking for someone to help her gather treats for the holiday... maybe you could help her out?

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2496|e386ad41.name: Baron Revilgaz
2496|e386ad41.text:
Welcome to Booty Bay, partner.  I hope your stay in my town is enjoyable and uneventful - emphasis on the latter.  We've got plenty of drink if you're thirsty, and plenty of bouncers if you're antsy.

Now then... what can this humble servant of the Steamwheedle Cartel do for you?  Better still - what can you do for me, eh?

276803|cec8f55c.name: Swift Blue Raptor
276803|cec8f55c.text: <The golden eyes of this raptor follow you with a wicked glint.>

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3004|dfa12b04.name: Tepa
3004|dfa12b04.text: You are truly a determined student. I will be happy to provide you with instruction!

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3320|ae78a458.name: Soran
3320|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3345|335c06e7.name: Godan
3345|335c06e7.text: You may have what it takes. Let's find out!

3373|6043e59b.name: Arnok
3373|6043e59b.text: I am an orc of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6746|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Pala
6746|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

6807|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Skindle
6807|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

9559|c670fd35.name: Grizzlowe
9559|c670fd35.text: I must say, Booty Bay has the best Clam Chowder to be had anywhere in the South Seas. Oh, not interested in cuisine eh? Well then let me be the first to welcome you to the berth of the Maiden's Fancy, the finest passenger ship to travel between the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor. She's due back for another trip to Ratchet in the Barrens soon, so make yourself comfortable till she arrives.

25-accept.name: Mastok Wrilehiss
25-accept.text:
If you want to be useful, then why don't you do something about the situation near Talondeep Path?

The transports between Ashenvale and Stonetalon are at a standstill because of the lake coming alive and attacking anything that gets close... which means anyone on the path.  What'd be even more useful than just putting the hammer down on the water elementals there is someone scouting the gazebo on Mystral Lake - the one that has a solid view of the Alliance outpost there.

You up for being useful?
25-accept.title: Stonetalon Standstill

6561-accept.name: Unknown
6561-accept.text:
Strength has left me. Your help is needed!

Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well.

Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters.

The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power.

Slay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in Thunder Bluff, $N, please.
6561-accept.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6563-accept.name: Dread
6563-accept.text:
Within the beginning tunnels of Blackfathom Deeps, large sapphire clusters can be found along the cave walls. Recently it was noted that the naga were harvesting the crystals. Until it can be discerned why, I sense we should stop the naga from succeeding. The crystals have great elemental power and if used inappropriately, could make for a powerful arcane component.

Will you help me, $N? Blackfathom Deeps can be found along Zoram Strand to the north of our outpost.
6563-accept.title: The Essence of Aku'Mai

6921-accept.name: Razy
6921-accept.text:
The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.  Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us.  If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good.

$N, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water.  In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity.  If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!
6921-accept.title: Amongst the Ruins

6922-accept.name: Unknown
6922-accept.text:
The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe.  You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy.  Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about.  The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force.

If anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring.  He is located at the Horde's Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
6922-accept.title: Baron Aquanis

8312-accept.name: Spoops
8312-accept.text:
I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick.  If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have!  I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!

Each of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for!  Also, a $r named Kali Remik in Sen'jin Village is handing out candy as well.  When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
8312-accept.title: Hallow's End Treats for Spoops!

8312-complete.name: Spoops
8312-complete.text:
Wow, you got them all!  You're awesome!

Thank you for trick-or-treating for me.  Here, take these pumpkin treats - I think you'll like them a lot!

Happy Hallow's End, $N!
8312-complete.title: Hallow's End Treats for Spoops!

8312-progress.name: Spoops
8312-progress.text: Have you finished trick-or-treating yet?  I'm sad that I can't go because I'm sick, but you helping me out makes me feel a little better...
8312-progress.title: Hallow's End Treats for Spoops!

8354-accept.name: Innkeeper Norman
8354-accept.text:
Ah, trick-or-treating for a sick child, are we?  I was going to say, you're a little old to be rummaging about for candies...

Well, for my treat - an Undercity Mint - you will need to... cluck like a chicken!  Yes, chickens love mints... well OK, maybe they don't LOVE them... but I won't give you a mint unless you chicken cluck for me!

Well $c, are you up to the challenge or not?!  Time to earn your treat!
8354-accept.title: Chicken Clucking for a Mint

8354-complete.name: Innkeeper Norman
8354-complete.text:
Too funny!  Well done, $N!  Here's your treat.

Happy Hallow's End!
8354-complete.title: Chicken Clucking for a Mint

8358-accept.name: Kali Remik
8358-accept.text:
A trick-or-treater!  Yeah mon!

Well now, even though you're doing something noble and collecting candies for a sick child, I can't let you off the hook that easily.  I have a yummy Darkspear Gumdrop to give to the sick child... if you make a train noise for me!  Haha, yes, that'll be the trick!  The price of this gumdrop is one train noise!

Chugga-chugga, $c!
8358-accept.title: Incoming Gumdrop

8358-complete.name: Kali Remik
8358-complete.text:
Woo-woo!  Well done, $N!  Here's your treat.

Happy Hallow's End!
8358-complete.title: Incoming Gumdrop

8359-accept.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
8359-accept.text:
That's an... interesting costume you have on.  Even though you're being nice and helping a sick child trick-or-treat this year, I'm afraid I'm going to have to ask you perform a trick for me!

Let's see... you look so strong and buff in that... costume... let's see you flex!  Yes, go on now and flex for me, strong man!

When and only when you flex, I'll give you some tasty Orgrimmar Nougat.  It's a great Hallow's End treat.
8359-accept.title: Flexing for Nougat

8359-complete.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
8359-complete.text:
You are truly mighty, haha!  Well done, and thanks for being such a good sport.  Here's your candy.

Happy Hallow's End, $N!
8359-complete.title: Flexing for Nougat

8360-accept.name: Innkeeper Pala
8360-accept.text:
Even though you're trick-or-treating for a sick child, you still need to perform a trick for the treat!  We can't very well change the tradition, now can we...

I believe the cost of a piece of marzipan nowadays is to bust out and DANCE!  That's right, let me see your moves!  Dance for me, and I'll give you some tasty marzipan!
8360-accept.title: Dancing for Marzipan

8360-complete.name: Innkeeper Pala
8360-complete.text:
You're quite the dancing machine, $N!

Here's your treat for being such a good sport.  Happy Hallow's End, and give my best to your sick little friend!  I hope they get better soon.
8360-complete.title: Dancing for Marzipan
